# bioexcel/biobb_amber/cphstats_run

## Summary

Wrapper of the AmberTools (AMBER MD Package) cphstats tool module.

Analyzing the results of constant pH MD simulations using cphstats tool from the AMBER MD package.

Nextflow adapter of the [CphstatsRun](https://biobb-amber.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cphstats.html#module-cphstats.cphstats_run) building block of [biobb_amber](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber) 5.3.3.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_AMBER_CPHSTATS_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_amber/cphstats_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_AMBER_CPHSTATS_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_cpin_path` | yes | cpin | Input constant pH file (AMBER cpin) |
| `input_cpout_path` | yes | cpout, zip, gzip | Output constant pH file (AMBER cpout) |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_dat_path` | yes | dat, out, txt, o | Output file to which the standard calcpka-type statistics are written |
| `output_population_path` | no, opt-in | dat, out, txt, o | Output file where protonation state populations are printed for every state of every residue |
| `output_chunk_path` | no, opt-in | dat, out, txt, o | Output file where the time series data calculated over chunks of the simulation are printed |
| `output_cumulative_path` | no, opt-in | dat, out, txt, o | Output file where the cumulative time series data is printed |
| `output_conditional_path` | no, opt-in | dat, out, txt, o | Output file with requested conditional probabilities |
| `output_chunk_conditional_path` | no, opt-in | dat, out, txt, o | Output file with a time series of the conditional probabilities over a trajectory split up into chunks |
| `versions_biobb_amber` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_amber', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of CphstatsRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_population_path: 'dat']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_amber container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_AMBER_CPHSTATS_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [timestep: 0.002]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timestep` | number | 0.002 | Simulation time step -in ps-, used to print data as a function of time. |
| `verbose` | boolean | false | Controls how much information is printed to the calcpka-style output file. Options are: False - Just print fraction protonated. True - Print everything calcpka prints. |
| `interval` | integer | 1000 | Interval between which to print out time series data like chunks, cumulative data, and running averages. It is also used as the window of the conditional probability time series. |
| `protonated` | boolean | true | Print out protonation fraction instead of deprotonation fraction in time series data. |
| `pka` | boolean | false | Print predicted pKas -via Henderson-Hasselbalch equation- in place of fraction -de-protonated. |
| `calcpka` | boolean | true | Triggers the calcpka-style output. |
| `running_avg_window` | integer | 100 | Defines a window size -in MD steps- for a moving, running average time series. |
| `chunk_window` | integer | 100 | Computes the time series data over a chunk of the simulation of this specified size -window- time steps. |
| `cumulative` | boolean | false | Computes the cumulative average time series data over the course of the trajectory. |
| `fix_remd` | string | "" | This option will trigger cphstats to reassemble the titration data into pH-specific ensembles. This is an exclusive mode of the program, no other analyses will be done. |
| `conditional` | string | "" | Evaluates conditional probabilities. CONDITIONAL should be a string of the format: <resid>:<state>,<resid>:<state>,... or <resid>:PROT,<resid>:DEPROT,... or <resid>:<state1>;<state2>,<resid>:PROT,... where <resid> is the residue number in the prmtop and <state> is either the state number or -p-rotonated or -d-eprotonated, case-insensitive. |
| `binary_path` | string | "cphstats" | Path to the cphstats executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
